title: Draw by Description · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw by Description · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Prepare a simple arrangement of shapes on a hidden sheet. The lead describes the shapes and positions without showing the sheet; a partner draws them. The drawing preserves the stated shapes and their relative positions. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw by Description, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The drawing preserves the stated shapes and their relative positions.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The drawing preserves the stated shapes and their relative positions.
